title: KaraokeParty character
description: A designer's character brief. Production settings and evidence are generated separately.

height.description: Standing barefoot supporting-heel-to-skull-crown physical height in feet and inches; exclude hair, headwear, footwear and props. Production preserves this anatomical scale across every angle. Example: 5 ft 9 in.

detail_level.description: Requested visual detail level. Each integer from 1 (least possible detail) through 10 (Illustrative Realism) selects one pinned single-frame detail reference.

props.description: Props the character holds in the key art and the projection views.

propNames.description: Props held here, by name, each a file in props/. Empty hands are an empty list or no list at all.

animation.description: The performance intent as prose, or that prose plus the traced motion sheet that drives the set. A sheet is named, never pathed: the pipeline knows where sheets live, and "auto" has one chosen.

motion.description: Name of a traced MotionArtist sheet, e.g. "zs-loop", or "auto" to have one chosen.

animationDescriptions.description: Required character-specific performance intent for every supported animation. Prose, not identifiers — optionally alongside the name of a traced motion sheet to drive the set.
